title.narrative: Fundación Abogados y abogadas del Noroeste argentino en Derechos Humanos y Estudios Sociales (ANDHES)

description.narrative: The Fundación Abogados y Abogados del Noroeste Argentina en Derechos Humanos y Estudios Sociales (ANDHES) contributes to social change through the defense of human rights and the democratization of social relations. Its work focuses on education and political advocacy to influence public policies and increase access to human rights for young people; LGBTIQ+ people; migrant women; indigenous and peasant groups. The organization carries out important work on the sexual and reproductive rights of migrant women in the border area; and offers legal support for trans and non-binary youth; and women survivors of violence.The grant will support the following specific priorities:- Contribute to the empowerment of cis, trans and lesbian women and girls so that they have more opportunities in their role as agents of social transformation towards a society with gender equality and free of violence;- Influence the design and implementation of public policies that promote gender equality and the eradication of violence against cis, trans and lesbian women and girls.
